title: Rubric files conflate moeb-project and moeb-invocation criteria
description:
The rubric system has two distinct namespaces that have bled together because moeb acts on itself. Moeb-invocation rubrics govern how moeb behaves as a tool during any invocation on any project; moeb-project rubrics govern the quality of the moeb codebase itself. The two categories are currently mixed across the same files with no separation.

Specific contaminations identified:
- `moeb-tool-origin` lives in `.moeb/rubrics/global.rubrics.md` (project location) but is a universal invocation rubric that should apply to all projects; it belongs in `src/moeb/internal/rubrics/global.rubrics.md`.
- `new-artifact-naming-schema` lives in `.moeb/rubrics/run.rubrics.md` (project location) but governs moeb artifact naming conventions across all projects; it belongs in `src/moeb/internal/rubrics/run.rubrics.md`.
- `no-signal-reoccurrence` lives in `.moeb/rubrics/catalogue.rubrics.md` (project catalogue) but is a universal invocation rubric; it belongs in `src/moeb/internal/rubrics/run.rubrics.md`.
- `all-skill-files-parity` lives in `src/moeb/internal/rubrics/global.rubrics.md` (universal location) but explicitly names moeb's three canonical skill files (run.skill.md, spec.skill.md, fix_signal.skill.md) — it is a moeb-project rubric and belongs in `.moeb/rubrics/global.rubrics.md`.
- `context-budget` lives in `src/moeb/internal/rubrics/run.rubrics.md` (universal location) but enforces moeb's own 300-line code quality standard, not a constraint applicable to all projects; it belongs in `.moeb/rubrics/run.rubrics.md`.
- `new-skill-mandatory-phases` in `.moeb/rubrics/catalogue.rubrics.md` duplicates `skill-mandatory-phases` already in `src/moeb/internal/rubrics/global.rubrics.md`; it should be retired.
- `no-dead-code` in `src/moeb/assets/rubrics/run.rubrics.md` should move to `src/moeb/internal/rubrics/run.rubrics.md`; the assets file must remain blank (moeb init template).
proposed_resolution:
1. Move to `src/moeb/internal/rubrics/global.rubrics.md`: `moeb-tool-origin` (from `.moeb/rubrics/global.rubrics.md`).
2. Move to `src/moeb/internal/rubrics/run.rubrics.md`: `new-artifact-naming-schema` (from `.moeb/rubrics/run.rubrics.md`), `no-signal-reoccurrence` (from `.moeb/rubrics/catalogue.rubrics.md`), `no-dead-code` (from `src/moeb/assets/rubrics/run.rubrics.md`).
3. Move to `.moeb/rubrics/global.rubrics.md`: `all-skill-files-parity` (from `src/moeb/internal/rubrics/global.rubrics.md`).
4. Move to `.moeb/rubrics/run.rubrics.md`: `context-budget` (from `src/moeb/internal/rubrics/run.rubrics.md`).
5. Retire `new-skill-mandatory-phases` from `.moeb/rubrics/catalogue.rubrics.md` (set status to superseded, note superseded by `skill-mandatory-phases` in internal).
6. Blank out `src/moeb/assets/rubrics/run.rubrics.md` to the empty-table template (header row only) so moeb init produces clean project rubric stubs.
